description: This PHP source file handles JWT token verification, including signature validation, token data validation, and logging. It interacts with external key files and Microsoft online login services.

methods.name: VerifyToken
methods.description: Verifies a JWT token by checking its structure, signature, and payload data validity.

methods.name: VerifySignature
methods.description: Verifies the JWT token's signature using the public key fetched from Microsoft online service.

methods.name: VerifyTokenData
methods.description: Validates the token's issued at, not before, and expiration times, and tenant ID.

methods.name: WritePubKey
methods.description: Writes the public key to a file in PEM format.

methods.name: LogTokenData
methods.description: Logs token-related data and validation results to a log file.

methods.name: base64decode_url
methods.description: Decodes a URL-safe base64 encoded string.

methods.name: CheckModTimeValid
methods.description: Checks if the key file modification time is within the last four hours.
